probe.note: Technical probing only. Semantic identification is the vision layer's job.

heuristicSignal.note: detect_cs2 heuristics were treated as a routing hint only; identity comes from the classification record below.

evidenceRefs: both views: Browning-derived polymer-framed striker pistol — squared slide, no exposed hammer, no external thumb safety
front.png: 'GLOCK(18)' slide roll-mark at x 1330..1500 and 'G18' engraved on the breech face at x 925..1045
both views: hinged trigger-safety blade splitting the trigger shoe face
front.png: single right-side ejection port, x 880..1145, with the steel breech visible through it
alpha trace: Glock frame signature — 22.4 deg grip rake, squared trigger-guard loop, beavertail tang overhanging the backstrap
alpha trace: four accessory-rail slots on the dust-cover underside, x 1552..1800
both views: magazine extension protruding below the magwell mouth with 6 front serrations — the +2 baseplate CS2 models the 18 with
rejectedAlternatives: knife (any subtype): the silhouette carries a slide, a trigger-guard loop and a magazine well; no blade, no crossguard
usp-s / p2000: those have an external hammer and a rounded trigger guard; this has neither
five-seven / tec-9: frame length and grip rake do not match; no Glock roll-mark
glock-17/19: the roll-mark reads GLOCK(18) explicitly

adapterProvenance.reason: the img2threejs CS2 adapter table shipped knife-only, so a Glock-18 would otherwise return unsupported-family. A knife component tree was NOT substituted; a pistol/glock-18 adapter was added (forge/stage2_spec/cs2_adapters.py) with its own component tree, painted regions, feature targets and review viewpoints.

finish.pattern: translucent crimson polymer over visible internals, with cybernetic circuit linework: magenta trace bundle on the rear slide, orange ribbon bundle across the mid slide, bar-graph glyphs at both slide ends, and the GHOST (*) / PROTOCOL / >_ decal set
finish.wear: Well-Worn reads as polymer worn through to bright metal along the magwell mouth (x 178..640, y 858..940) plus scuffing along the silhouette edge

camera.note: both views are flat broadside product renders with negligible perspective; reproduced by an orthographic camera at halfHeight 1.125 on +Z / -Z

assumptions.float: unknown — 'Well-Worn' is a user-supplied label, not measured
assumptions.hiddenRegions: inferred — no view shows the top strap, the underside, the muzzle face or inside the shell
assumptions.thickness: inferred — both views are broadside; Z comes from published Glock-18 cross-sections scaled by the traced height
assumptions.internals: the barrel, recoil rod, breech body and magazine body are placed from what the translucent shell reveals plus mechanism knowledge; their Z depth is not observable

warnings: family was outside the shipped adapter table; an adapter was authored rather than substituting the knife tree

viewPairing.verdict: same silhouette, genuinely different surface pixels -> not a duplicate view
